mini_batch_wall_clock_stop.rule: before each start the runner measures elapsed batch wall time; if elapsed >= 3300s, or elapsed + case_timeout_s > 3300s, no further starts are issued and the batch closes; 300s is reserved for upload/readback

stage1.purpose: bracket target lift without Mach-specific alpha calibration

regression_spec.points_used: all valid stage1 rows at the nearest Mach (up to 49)
regression_spec.estimator: ordinary least squares CL on alpha
regression_spec.outlier_rule: drop rows with invalid tokens; require >=5 valid rows and R^2>=0.99; if not met, stage2 is not built and the case is null (no rerun, no interpolation)

stage2.center: local ordinary-least-squares regression of stage1 polar CL(alpha) evaluated at cl_target
stage2.purpose: produce a raw polar row within lift tolerance; no interpolation admitted; bracketing is NOT required, only a raw row within tolerance

quantitative_justification.conclusion: at a conservative local slope of 0.020/deg, worst nearest-point induced CL error is 1e-5, over 10x below the 1.086e-4 absolute tolerance; even a 50% slope error (0.030 predicted vs 0.020 actual) shifts the target by only 0.0033 deg, well inside the 0.006 deg half-width

stage2.ols_disclosure: The OLS fit is a modeling step used only to choose the stage2 grid center. It is not used for admission; admission requires a raw stage2 polar row within 1e-3 relative lift tolerance. Fit quality is reported (n points, R^2) per case.

admission.criterion: only a raw stage2 polar row satisfying |L_a - L_target| <= 1e-3*L_target through RealAdmissionManifest is admitted
admission.audit: separate local reimplementation audit_real_case.py; not human and not A5

label_acceptance.denominator: completed stage2 starts with case_result and polar

stop_conditions: any timeout or missing process result
accounting ledger not conserved after a mini-batch
any raw hash mismatch or upload/readback mismatch

stage2 unavailable for >20% of completed stage1 cases in the SAME mini-batch (authoritative denominator = that mini-batch only; the cumulative rate is reported for disclosure but does not trigger STOP)

accounting.charged_rule: each VSPAERO process start counts 1; retries 0

upload.after_each_mini_batch: push raw+logs+accounting and read back SHA256SUMS from remote before next mini-batch

maml.scope: after G2 labels only; zero additional VSPAERO starts

a5_requirement: independent deepseek-flash read-only review of this preregistration and stage1 manifest before first start

a5_review_binding.self_hash_method: dossier_payload_sha256 = sha256 of all dossier bytes before the marker line '<!-- SELF_HASH -->'; the hash value is printed in section 8 after the marker, so the verifier truncates at the marker and recomputes
a5_review_binding.note: a file cannot contain its own full SHA256; the payload hash is the verifiable binding

null_classification.NULL_STAGE1_NOT_BRACKETED: stage1 raw rows do not bracket cl_target (e.g. M140 near the 10 deg window edge); case is null, no window extension, no rerun
null_classification.NULL_STAGE1_REGRESSION_UNRELIABLE: fewer than 5 valid same-Mach stage1 rows or R^2<0.99; stage2 not built; case null
null_classification.NULL_STAGE2_NO_RAW_ROW_WITHIN_TOLERANCE: stage2 ran but no raw row meets |L-L_target|<=1e-3*L_target; case null, tolerance not relaxed, no interpolation
null_classification.NULL_SOLVER_NO_RESULT: start issued but no process result (timeout/crash); case null, not rerun

expected_outcomes.rationale: M140's eight designs may fail to bracket the 10 deg window edge and are the main expected null source; all other tasks have CL targets well inside the window. No label rate is promised; null cases are reported, not hidden.
